title: Partial-Revelation Panel Forecasting: Predictive Information Gain, Allocation, and Coarsening-Consistent Operators
abstract: arXiv:2610.22831v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study partial-revelation panel forecasting: given $k$ of $n$ annotator votes on the previous dialogue turn, predict the full count distribution of the next turn's panel. This cross-turn predictive information differs from same-item annotation value. Under any nested revelation mechanism, the population decrement satisfies $V(k)-V(k+1)=I(Y;R_{k+1}\mid X_k)$; a fitted model also contributes adjacent excess-risk differences. Coarsened-completely-at-random (CCAR) masking supplies the exchangeable random-rater interpretation used in our operators. We define coarsening-consistent panel operators with a closed-form Dirichlet-multinomial realization, learned completion, and rater-count transfer. Against per-level lookup, cold-start count negative log-likelihood differences are -0.422/-0.166/-0.014 nats on IEMOCAP/M3ED/EmoWOZ. A held-out rater experiment measures same-item value: first and second additional votes reduce NLL by 0.583/0.221, 0.5

translated_title: 部分揭示面板预测：预测信息增益、分配与粗化一致算子
translated_abstract: 我们研究部分揭示面板预测问题：给定上一轮对话中 n 个标注者投票中的 k 个，预测下一轮面板的完整计数分布。这种跨轮预测信息不同于同条目的标注价值。在任何嵌套揭示机制下，总体减量满足 $V(k)-V(k+1)=I(Y;R_{k+1}\mid X_k)$；拟合模型也贡献相邻超额风险差异。完全随机粗化（CCAR）掩码为我们算子中使用的可交换随机评分者解释提供了基础。我们定义了粗化一致面板算子，并给出闭式狄利克雷-多项式实现、学习式补全以及评分者数量迁移。与逐级查找基线相比，冷启动计数负对数似然差异在 IEMOCAP/M3ED/EmoWOZ 上分别为 -0.422/-0.166/-0.014 nats。一项留出评分者实验衡量了同条目价值：第一张和第二张额外投票分别使 NLL 降低 0.583/0.221、0.5……
tldr: 该论文提出部分揭示面板预测框架，证明了嵌套揭示机制下预测信息增益的恒等式，并设计了具有闭式狄利克雷-多项式实现的粗化一致面板算子，在多个情感对话数据集上显著改善了冷启动计数预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a partial-revelation panel forecasting framework, establishes an identity characterizing predictive information gain under nested revelation mechanisms, and introduces coarsening-consistent panel operators with a closed-form Dirichlet-multinomial realization, substantially improving cold-start count prediction across emotion dialogue datasets.
